content: PyInstaller 6.0+ uses symlinks in onedir builds on all POSIX platforms (not just macOS .app), so onedir output must stay on / be copied to a filesystem supporting symlinks and copied with a command that preserves them (macOS 'cp -fR' preserves symlinks; 'cp -fr' does not necessarily). --add-data payloads copied into the bundle do not automatically get symlink treatment unless explicitly structured that way. UPX-compressed binaries fail codesign validation on macOS/arm64 and must not be used when the output needs to be signed/notarized. LSUIElement in a custom Info.plist can be ignored/overridden by PyInstaller's bootloader process re-parenting behavior, causing a dock icon/menu bar to appear despite the setting.
